title: Vendors coded inconsistently across accounts or departments
prompt: Identify vendors whose expenses are coded inconsistently across accounts or departments over the last quarter.

setup.q: Which vendors are allowed to be coded to more than one account or department (and which)?

inputs.name: Approved account and department coding guide

steps: pull the quarter's expense transactions with vendor, account and department
run coding_consistency with the allowed splits removed
rank vendors by the amount coded away from their usual account
write the workbook with a transaction link per exception

done.text: Every exception row cites the vendor id and each transaction id
vendor-coding-exceptions.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Vendors on the allowed-splits list do not appear as exceptions; different services that justify different coding are noted, not flagged
